title: Python Gate
statement: Implement `solve(major, minor)`. Return `ok` when the version is at least 3.12, and `reject` otherwise. Compare the pair, not a float.
hints: Do not concatenate the numbers into 312.

approaches.name: Direct
approaches.explanation: requires-python rejects an interpreter that is too old at install time.

editorial: requires-python rejects an interpreter that is too old at install time. Comparing tuples avoids the trick where 3.9 would look larger than 3.12 if you compared strings poorly, and where 3.10 is not the float 3.1. The gate is the minimum the service is tested on.
